title: Liverpool's 2007 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Liverpool against AC Milan in the 2007 Champions League final (23 May 2007), when they lost 2-1. The goalkeeper (Pepe Reina) is left out.

notes.Harry Kewell: Harry Kewell came on as a substitute in the 2007 final, so he did not start.
notes.Peter Crouch: Peter Crouch came on as a substitute in the 2007 final, so he did not start.
notes.Alvaro Arbeloa: Alvaro Arbeloa came on as a substitute in the 2007 final, so he did not start.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
